value.rationale: The natural full fixed-gap family h>=2 was not resolved by the consecutive-generator exact formula. The theorem gives a uniform explicit quadratic quasi-polynomial and settles its true minimal period, a natural invariant controlling the complexity of residue-class descriptions. It also proves exact period rigidity despite removal of noncoprime a. This is a structural two-parameter extension, not merely an isolated numerical identity.
